title: Separable functors and firm modules
author: Patrik Lundstr\"om
difficulty_reason: Counted unit: the article's thm  (source0.tex lines 1789-1797). The statement reads: thm Let B be a firm ring and suppose that f : B A is a firm ring homomorphism. Then the functor f : B A is separable if and only if f is a split monomorphism in the category of B -bimodules. thm. The retained complete proof (lines 1799-1991, 193 lines) is the article's own argument, retained line for line.
